controls.name: C1 the race is planted and the DEFECT reproduces

controls.can_fail_because: if the planted line is not in a POSITIONAL path, or authors_of does not resolve it, C1 goes quiet and the probe has measured nothing
controls.null_must_contain: the unrepaired arm must be CAPABLE of agreeing: if the pre-check and the landed commit both report the same trailer, the race did not land and there is no defect here to repair

controls.name: C2 the repaired commit declares the trailer
controls.must_fire_because: the whole point: the record must match the object

controls.null_must_contain: the repaired arm must be CAPABLE of coming out empty -- an amend that appends nothing leaves the same bare message the unrepaired arm had

controls.name: C3 the amend is MESSAGE-ONLY
controls.must_fire_because: bare `git commit --amend` takes the SHARED index (H19) — the remedy must not commit the defect class it removes
controls.can_fail_because: a co-lane's file is deliberately left STAGED before the amend; if `--only` does not hold, it is swept in
controls.null_must_contain: the tree pair must be CAPABLE of differing and COLANE.txt of appearing: a bare `--amend` in place of the scoped one produces exactly that, which is the arm this control exists to catch
